issues_detected.description: No processing documentation reaches the typed slots. preprocessing_strategies, cleaning_strategies, labeling_strategies, machine_annotation_tools, annotation_analyses, imputation_protocols and missing_data_documentation are all absent, while the free-text `notes` field carries a full description of the MuSIC pipeline (node2vec PPI embedding, Human Protein Atlas deep-learning image embedding, contrastive co-embedding, multi-resolution community detection, Gene Ontology/Reactome alignment and LLM assembly naming) and external_resources carries the Cell Mapping Toolkit GitHub and readthedocs URLs. The content exists but is not machine-addressable at the slots a consumer would query.
issues_detected.recommendation: Move the MuSIC pipeline steps into preprocessing_strategies/labeling_strategies with the source caveat that computed cell maps are not in this release, and record the QC applied to the released input streams under cleaning_strategies.

issues_detected.description: conforms_to_standard asserts RO_CRATE as a structured enum value, but the adjacent conforms_to prose and source_caveats both state that the RO-Crate packaging claim is carried from the tier-3 preprint and the tier-5 March 2025 and June 2025 releases, and that 'the June 2026 release page does not itself restate the packaging format'. The hedge is present in prose and absent from the enum a consumer reads.
issues_detected.recommendation: Either drop the enum assertion for this release or add a note on the enum entry naming the release it was carried from, so the structured value and the prose make the same claim.

issues_detected.description: Embargo status conflicts between slots. raw_data_sources lists 'Perturb-seq data in KOLF2.1J iPSCs (undifferentiated)' and 'Perturb-seq data in MDA-MB-468 breast cancer cells' with access_details 'Embargoed', while file_collections distributes cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_cell_atlas.zip and cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_raw_sra.zip and subsets describes both as released holdings. The two statements are reconcilable (the released archives are plausibly derived summaries and accession manifests, at 30.2 KB and 73.3 KB) but the record does not reconcile them.
issues_detected.recommendation: State in the perturb-seq file_collections notes what the released archive contains relative to the embargoed underlying data.

issues_detected.description: Series version numbering reads as non-monotonic: this June 2026 release is version '2.0' while version_access lists the earlier June 2025 (doi:10.18130/V3/F3TD5R) and October 2025 (doi:10.18130/V3/K7TGEM) releases as 'Version 2.1'. Each quarterly release is a separate Dataverse dataset with its own counter, but the record does not say so, and a reader comparing the list can read 2.1 as newer than 2.0.
issues_detected.recommendation: Note in versions_available that version numbers are internal to each release DOI, or order the list explicitly by release date.

issues_detected.description: The single access URL in distribution_formats, 'https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/api/access/datafile/', is the Data Access API base path and does not resolve without an appended datafile id. Neither the release DOI landing page nor a download_url is given anywhere as a URL: `page` points to the project portal https://cm4ai.org/ rather than to the release.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add the release landing page (https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/HIGT4C) as an access URL and describe the id-appending pattern in the format notes.

issues_detected.description: is_deidentified is populated (identifiable_elements_present: false) with no participant_privacy block and no reidentification_risk statement. For a cell-line dataset with no human participants this is defensible, but the KOLF2.1J line is donor-derived and carries genome-scale sequencing, and the record makes no reidentification-risk statement about it.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a short reidentification-risk statement for the donor-derived iPSC line rather than leaving the privacy slots silent.

issues_detected.description: keywords carries 'mass spectroscopy' where the technique described throughout the record is mass spectrometry. The term appears to be a faithful transcription of the source keyword list rather than an authoring error, but it is the only keyword covering the technique.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add 'mass spectrometry' alongside the verbatim source term.

issues_detected.description: known_biases carries a single representation_bias entry with no mitigation_strategy and no affected_subsets, while the record elsewhere holds the material for at least a selection-bias entry: sampling_strategies records targeted, non-random selection of cell lines and perturbation targets and is_representative: false, and known_limitations records incomplete overlap between the SEC-MS, imaging and perturb-seq protein sets.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a selection_bias entry drawn from sampling_strategies and attach affected_subsets and a mitigation_strategy to the existing representation_bias entry.

issues_detected.description: Use guidance is only half populated: intended_uses (4) and prohibited_uses (2, each with a sourced reason) are present, while discouraged_uses and future_use_impacts are absent. known_limitations states that the release suits analysis of individual datasets rather than integrated cell maps and that interpretation requires domain expertise, which is discouraged-use content sitting in a limitations slot, and no forward-looking impact or mitigation analysis appears anywhere.
issues_detected.recommendation: Promote the two limitation statements to discouraged_uses and add future_use_impacts covering generalization beyond the two cell lines, with the Ethics module governance framework as the stated mitigation.

semantic_insights: DOI 10.18130/V3/HIGT4C uses the University of Virginia Dataverse (Libra Data) prefix 10.18130 correctly, and the same DOI is used consistently as `id`, `doi`, `version_access.latest_version_doi` and the citation target.

Grant number 1OT2OD032742-01 follows NIH format correctly (OT2 activity code, OD institute), and the funders note additionally records 5U54HG012513-02 as Bridge2AI Bridge Center support attributed to the project rather than to this release.

Fragment identifiers minted on the record's own DOI (doi:10.18130/V3/HIGT4C#person-axelsson-u, #subset-*, #files-*) are used consistently for creators without ORCIDs, for subsets and for file collections, and the subset and file-collection ids cross-reference each other in both directions.

Scope discipline is strong: the Nature 2025 U2OS multimodal cell map paper is recorded under related_datasets with relationship_type 'references' and named in source_caveats as a distinct dataset by the same investigators, rather than being absorbed into this release's holdings.

Project-level counts from the CM4AI web pages (1,374 protein interactions, 53,788 images, 21.4 TB) are explicitly withheld from release-level slots in source_caveats rather than asserted as this release's totals.
Per-archive MD5 checksums are recorded for all 10 file collections, giving file-level integrity evidence that the record's provenance slots otherwise lack.

total_file_count: 10 reconciles exactly with the 10 file_collections entries, and the 9 subsets map one-to-one onto the 9 data archives with cm4ai_release_metadata.zip as the tenth, metadata-typed collection.

Temporal ordering is coherent: created_on 2025-02-27 (deposit), issued 2026-06-17 (release), last_updated_on 2026-07-15 (the three immunofluorescence archives published a month later), and source_caveats flags the release page's own anomalous 2025-06-30 description date rather than silently adopting it.
instances carry Bridge2AI ontology CURIEs (B2AI_SUBSTRATE:19/58/59/64, B2AI_TOPIC:15/26/34) typed per modality, which is the record's clearest semantic-interoperability signal.

human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects: false, is_deidentified.identifiable_elements_present: false and sensitive_elements_present: false are mutually consistent and each carries the same sourced rationale (non-clinical tissue-culture data unmatched to a human subject).

strengths: Sourcing discipline is the record's strongest property: source_caveats states the release the values come from, withholds project-level counts that are not release-level totals, names the related U2OS Nature dataset as distinct rather than absorbing it, and flags the release page's own anomalous description date.

Sustainability documentation meets all four indicators: persistent identifier, domain-appropriate institutional repository, an explicit long-term preservation commitment backed by committed institutional funds, and a quarterly update schedule with a stated end date.

The holdings are enumerated completely and reconcile internally: 10 file collections with MD5 checksums, sizes, publication dates and collection types, total_file_count 10, and 9 subsets mapping one-to-one onto the 9 data archives.

weaknesses: No processing documentation reaches its typed slots: preprocessing, cleaning, labeling, annotation, imputation and missing-data fields are all empty, and the MuSIC pipeline description survives only in the free-text notes field.
